architectural-decision-records.why: the fix changes what the generator emits into every consumer's CI workflow (GATE_REPO_ROOT on the discrimination-test step), a decision with a real trade-off (pin the env vs. make gate root resolution layout-robust) that a future engineer would ask 'why' about, so it ships an ADR in the same change.
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR-0112 recording the overshooting-root problem, the three options, the chosen env pin, and the honest limit that it pins the env rather than fixing root resolution itself; it also records that this retires job-decoder's per-consumer ADR-0034 hand-patch.
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

judge-arch.why: the change edits the workflow-generation template, so before done it got a fresh-context review of every changed file against the four questions, with the test's step-scoping and mutation-sensitivity as the adversarial focus.
judge-arch.what: dispatched a fresh-context subagent review of the full diff; it returned a per-file x four-question matrix (all cleared/n-a), independently re-ran the mutation (48/2 reverted, 50/50 restored), confirmed the regex is scoped to the test step's own env block and the planted cases are unaffected. The review entry is in docs/arch-reviews/entries/.
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.

verifiable-quality-gates.why: the fix is proven by a new discrimination test, so that test must itself be shown non-vacuous: it has to fail when the template env line is removed, and must not pass merely because GATE_REPO_ROOT appears elsewhere in the file.
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added GENESIS ADR-0112 asserting GATE_REPO_ROOT inside the generated discrimination-test step's own env block (regex anchored on that step's unique name and unable to cross the run: line), then reverted the template line and confirmed the test fails ('the discrimination-test step must set GATE_REPO_ROOT in its own env block'); restored, suite 50/50.
quotes: test must FAIL when the check is replaced by a no-op

skeptical-audit.why: the claim 'consumers no longer need the hand-patch' is a factual assertion that must carry an evidence state, a re-runnable source, and a named limitation rather than be presumed.
skeptical-audit.what: recorded the fix as proven (mutation 48/2 -> 50/50, re-runnable via node --test test/esk-genesis.test.mjs) with the named limitation that no strict YAML-schema parse was run (correctness asserted by indentation against sibling keys plus the passing generator suite), and that already-genesis'd consumers adopt it only by re-genesis.
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it.

pattern-selector.why: no new class, module, service, or data flow is designed; the fix adds one env key to an existing generated workflow step, so no pattern is selected.

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system, service, schema, or algorithm is designed or changed; it is one line in a CI workflow template.

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: no input, auth, session, secret, file, network, or dependency surface changes; GATE_REPO_ROOT is set to the CI workspace path, not a secret or user input.

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: no user-facing behavior or audience use case changes; the change is an internal generator fix covered by a unit/discrimination test, not a Gherkin scenario surface.

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the existing esk-genesis unit suite is the right layer and already covers the generated workflow; no new integration, contract, load, or chaos layer is warranted for one template line.

release-deployment-safety.why: this change does not cut or deploy a release; it will be folded into a later version bump via changelog.d.

sre-operational-readiness.why: no running service, endpoint, SLO, or alert; this is a build-time generator template.

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal or regulated data and no storage, retention, migration, or backup surface.

arch-encode.why: the caught gap is already guarded by the new discrimination test (GENESIS ADR-0112); no additional greppable arch-gate rule is needed.

universal-browser-device-support.why: no browser or device surface; CI workflow YAML only.
